about: Triage quality test set (SCRUM-282). 50 realistic symptom descriptions, each with the urgency level a careful clinician would expect. Expected levels were written from the guidance in 'sources' and the level definitions in src/triage/urgency.js, before the cases were run, and must never be changed only to make a failing case pass. See README.md in this folder.

levels.emergency: Now: call 140 or go to the nearest emergency department.
levels.soon: See a doctor within 24 to 48 hours.
levels.routine: Self-care; book a regular appointment if it does not improve.

sources.nabad-levels: The four Nabad urgency levels and their timeframes (backend/src/triage/urgency.js, LEVELS).

cases.says: crushing pressure in my chest for 20 minutes, i'm sweating a lot and feel sick
cases.why: Chest pressure with sweating and nausea is a possible heart attack.

cases.says: my dad is 70, his face looks lopsided and he cant lift his right arm, it started about 10 minutes ago
cases.why: Face drooping and arm weakness are the F and A of FAST: a possible stroke happening now.

cases.says: ate shrimp and now my lips are swelling up, my throat feels tight and i feel dizzy
cases.why: Lip swelling, a tight throat and dizziness after a food are signs of anaphylaxis.

cases.says: my 4 year old swallowed one of those small round batteries from the tv remote
cases.why: A swallowed button battery can burn through the throat or gut within hours.

cases.says: fever since yesterday and now i cant bend my neck forward, and light really hurts my eyes
cases.why: Fever with a stiff neck and dislike of bright light are warning signs of meningitis.

cases.says: my grandmother suddenly doesn't know where she is and is talking nonsense, she was fine this morning
cases.why: Sudden confusion can be a stroke, sepsis or very low blood sugar.

cases.says: i've been throwing up stuff that looks like coffee grounds and my poop is black
cases.why: Coffee-ground vomit and black stools mean bleeding in the stomach or gut.

cases.says: worst headache of my life, it came on like a thunderclap while i was lifting at the gym
cases.why: A sudden, extremely severe headache can be bleeding in the brain.

cases.says: my son fell from the second floor balcony, he's awake but crying and can't move his legs
cases.why: A fall from a height with leg weakness is a possible spinal injury.

cases.says: i don't want to be alive anymore and i've been thinking about how to end it
cases.why: Thoughts of ending one's life with a plan forming need immediate support.

cases.says: i'm 34 weeks pregnant and i haven't felt the baby move since last night
cases.why: Reduced or absent fetal movements need checking straight away.

cases.says: my mum had a chest infection and today she's really drowsy, breathing fast and her skin looks blotchy and bluish
cases.why: Drowsiness, fast breathing and blotchy or blue skin after an infection are signs of sepsis.

cases.says: so um my chest has been really tight since i woke up and i feel like i cant get enough air
cases.why: Chest tightness with not getting enough air needs emergency care (dictated, no punctuation).

cases.says: sudden really bad pain in my left testicle, started an hour ago and i threw up
cases.why: Sudden severe testicle pain can be torsion, which needs surgery within hours.

cases.says: bad headache that started a few minutes ago
cases.why: Answering that the headache came on within a minute and is the worst ever makes it an emergency.

cases.says: my daughter has a fever and a rash on her legs
cases.why: A rash that does not fade under a glass with a fever can be meningitis or sepsis.

cases.says: fell on my wrist playing basketball, it's swollen and looks bent and i cant move it
cases.why: A swollen, bent wrist that cannot move is a probable fracture: seen today for an X-ray.

cases.says: my baby is 7 weeks old and her temperature is 38.3
cases.why: A temperature of 38°C or more in a baby under 3 months is high risk and needs a doctor today.

cases.says: really bad pain in the lower right side of my belly since last night, worse when i walk, and i threw up twice
cases.why: Severe lower right belly pain worse on walking, with vomiting, is possible appendicitis.

cases.says: diarrhea and vomiting since yesterday, i cant keep even water down and i've barely peed today
cases.why: Not keeping fluids down and passing little urine are signs of dehydration.

cases.says: i'm 10 weeks pregnant and started bleeding this morning with some cramping
cases.why: Bleeding with cramps in early pregnancy should be checked today.

cases.says: my 6 year old hit his head on the table corner, he's awake and talking but has a big bump and threw up once
cases.why: A head injury followed by vomiting should be assessed today.

cases.says: my temperature is 39.8, i have the shakes and my whole body aches
cases.why: Nabad's policy: a temperature of 39.5°C or higher is checked today.

cases.says: cut my hand on broken glass, it's deep and i can see something white inside
cases.why: A deep cut showing tissue underneath needs closing and checking today.

cases.says: bright red blood in my poop this morning and on the toilet paper
cases.why: Blood in the stool should be checked today (dark or black blood would be an emergency).

cases.says: splashed bleach in my eye while cleaning, it burns and it's really red
cases.why: A chemical in the eye needs rinsing and an eye check today.

cases.says: i haven't been able to pee at all since this morning and my lower belly feels full and painful
cases.why: Being unable to pass urine at all needs to be seen today.

cases.says: stomach ache since lunch
cases.why: Answering that the pain is severe and constant, or the belly is hard, makes it urgent.

cases.says: fever around 38.5 for two days and a bad cough
cases.why: A moderate fever lasting days with a cough should be seen by a doctor in a day or two.

cases.says: burning when i pee and i need to go all the time, started 2 days ago, no fever
cases.why: Likely urine infection without fever: a doctor within a day or two.

cases.says: my ear has been hurting since yesterday, it feels blocked and i cant hear well on that side
cases.why: Ear pain with reduced hearing can be an infection that a doctor should look at.

cases.says: itchy red rash on both arms for 4 days and it's spreading a bit
cases.why: A new spreading rash should be looked at by a doctor (no warning signs given).

cases.says: sore throat for over a week now and it's not getting better
cases.why: A sore throat lasting over a week without improving should be checked.

cases.says: been throwing up since this morning but i can keep water down, no blood
cases.why: Vomiting while still keeping fluids down, with no blood: a doctor if it goes on.

cases.says: my knee has been hurting for weeks, worse going up stairs
cases.why: Joint pain lasting weeks should be checked by a doctor.

cases.says: the cut on my leg from last week is now red, swollen and has some pus
cases.why: Redness, swelling and pus are signs of a wound infection.

cases.says: noticed blood in my pee this morning, no pain
cases.why: Blood in the urine should always be checked by a doctor.

cases.says: i get out of breath walking up the stairs lately
cases.why: Breathlessness only on exertion, not at rest, should be checked by a doctor.

cases.says: i've been getting headaches on and off since my car accident last year
cases.why: Recurring headaches over months need a doctor's review; the accident is history, not happening now.

cases.says: runny nose, sneezing and a scratchy throat since yesterday
cases.why: Common cold symptoms can be managed at home.

cases.says: mild headache after a long day staring at my laptop
cases.why: A mild tension-type headache with an obvious cause is self-care.

cases.says: bumped my shin on the bed, there's a bruise but i can walk fine
cases.why: A bruise with normal walking is self-care.

cases.says: feeling tired lately, i don't think i've been sleeping enough
cases.why: Tiredness with an obvious cause and no warning signs is self-care.

cases.says: no chest pain and no trouble breathing, just a dry cough and a bit of a cold
cases.why: The red flags are explicitly denied; what remains is a cold.

cases.says: my father died of a heart attack years ago. i just have a cough and wanted to check
cases.why: The heart attack is family history, not a current symptom.

cases.says: i had a stroke 3 years ago and recovered fully, now i just have a mild cold
cases.why: The stroke is past history; the current complaint is a mild cold.

cases.says: a bit of heartburn after a big spicy dinner
cases.why: Mild heartburn after a large meal is self-care.

cases.says: sore throat
cases.why: A mild sore throat for a few days that is improving, with no risk factors, is self-care.

cases.says: my eyes get itchy and watery every spring and it's happening again
cases.why: Seasonal itchy, watery eyes are hay fever: self-care.

cases.says: small paper cut on my finger, it already stopped bleeding
cases.why: A small cut that has stopped bleeding is self-care.
